import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    R,F=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get); noise=min(((v,c) for v in cnt if v!=bg),key=lambda vc:vc[1])[0]
    # separator lines: full rows/cols of a single non-bg color, different from noise
    sep=None
    for v in cnt:
        if v in (bg,noise): continue
        fr=sum(1 for r in range(R) if sum(x==v for x in g[r])==F)
        fc=sum(1 for j in range(F) if sum(g[i][j]==v for i in range(R))==R)
        if (fr or fc)>0: sep=v; break
    sr=[i for i in range(R) if sum(x==sep for x in g[i])==F]
    sc=[j for j in range(F) if sum(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(R))==R]
    rs=[-1]+sr+[R]; cs=[-1]+sc+[F]; out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def fill(a,b,c,d):
        n=sum(1 for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d) if g[i][j]!=bg)
        if n>=5:
            for i in range(a,b):
                for j in range(c,d): out[i][j]=noise
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
        for j in range(len(cs)-1):
            fill(rs[i]+1,rs[i+1],cs[j]+1,cs[j+1])
    return out
